name: gate-parallel-memory-capture-codecs-armv7
reason: Memory collection in parallel on the 32-bit ARMv7 gate target in the armhf user space on a c6g.4xlarge at 4b43bf74: capture qualify --stage timing on all 15 capture cases on CPU 1 with the RSS module unloaded, then --stage memory with the kernel RSS bound from those records, serially on CPU 1 on c05, c06, c10, c14 and c15 and in parallel on CPUs 1-15 on all 15 with per-case input copies; codecs memory of both workload lists in parallel on CPUs 1-15 under the kernel bound; and serial codecs memory of a few workloads from slot copies and, at 03cc8d3f, from the workers' own paths. Capture: heaps identical sample for sample, resident medians within the serial spread, verdicts equal; all 15 cases pass every gate, heap upper bounds 0.39-0.61 and total RSS 0.934-0.977, for the capture ARMv7 row's kernel-bound memory. Codecs against gate-codecs-memory-8154812e (same worker hashes): verdicts equal, reference heaps identical, candidate heaps shifted 8 bytes by the slot copy's path in 5 of 30 workloads, as the serial runs show. With the comparisons, step logs, timing records and correctness outputs (generated inputs left out, their hashes recorded), the measured worker hashes and the scripts
